security.//: Strict CSP: the webview may talk ONLY to the loopback daemon and the paired cloud host (auth + /v1). No unsafe-eval, no other remote origins. CLOUD_BASE is templated per channel (CN build points at the mainland ICP-filed gateway).
security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:* https://api.tangent.example; img-src 'self' data: https://api.tangent.example; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'

bundle.//externalBin: Tauri appends the target triple → resolves binaries/tangent-agentcore-<triple>(.exe), the PyInstaller sidecar CI drops into src-tauri/binaries/.

macOS.//signingIdentity: Developer ID Application — sourced from APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY in CI, never committed.

windows.//: Installer signed by Azure Trusted Signing in CI (NOT an EV cert). No cert fields here.

updater.//: Tauri signed auto-update. pubkey is the Ed25519 PUBLIC key; the matching PRIVATE key lives ONLY in CI secrets + a sealed backup vault (its loss is unrecoverable — see UPDATER.md). endpoints = the ICP-filed latest.json.
